title: Probing Multimodal Large Language Models on Cognitive Biases in Chinese Short-Video Misinformation

live_model.evidence: Abstract: "Gemini-2.5-Pro achieves the highest performance in the multimodal setting with a belief score of 71.5/100, while o3 performs the worst at 35.2."; Table 1 row 'o3-20250416'.

prompt.location: Appendix C ("All prompts used in this paper are provided in Appendix C")

claim.location: Abstract; Table 1, row o3-20250416; 200 short videos total (Table 6)

data.source: Manually annotated 200-video dataset; code at https://github.com/penguinnnnn/Fine-VDK, data at https://huggingface.co/datasets/penguin-G/

notes: Belief Score appears to be a self-reported numeric judgment elicited directly from the model (no separate LLM judge identified). Video/multimodal input drives token consumption very high for some settings (Table 6 reports up to ~21.8K tokens/video for o3), pushing cost to the high tier despite n=200.
